name: Karnal Edge Data Center
notes: Operator page says Velosting established an edge data center in Karnal at SCO no. 13, 2nd Floor, Sector 3, HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Karnal, with 12 racks; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Anant Raj Cloud Panchkula Data Center
developer: Anant Raj Cloud / Anant Raj Limited
notes: Times of India reported Anant Raj launched a second Haryana data center in Panchkula adding 7 MW of IT load. ETDatacenters later reported Anant Raj operated 28 MW across Manesar and Panchkula and planned expansion across Manesar, Panchkula, and Rai.

name: FlixTel DC Rewari
notes: Weak directory evidence: DataCenterJournal lists one FlixTel data center named FlixTel DC Rewari, while company-registry data confirms FlixTel Communication Private Limited is active with registered address at Kalaka (177), Rewari, Haryana 123401. Directory city metadata is internally inconsistent, so status and capacity are unknown.
